definitions.explanation: The punctuation mark ！, used for surprise, emphasis, or strong feeling. Not part of standard Japanese punctuation in formal writing, but common in informal writing, manga, and advertising.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文末|ぶんまつ}→文末：31682_bunmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感嘆符|かんたんふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける。
examples.english: To put an exclamation mark at the end of the sentence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{感嘆符|かんたんふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: You don't use exclamation marks in academic papers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{感嘆符|かんたんふ}⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧で、⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Her emails are full of exclamation marks, and just reading them cheers me up.

notes:
From ⟦{感嘆|かんたん}→感嘆：16165_kantan⟧ (exclamation, admiration) + {符|ふ} (mark). In everyday speech people usually say ビックリマーク or エクスクラメーション⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感嘆符|かんたんふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to add an exclamation mark
- {感嘆符|かんたんふ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{疑問符|ぎもんふ}→疑問符：24302_gimonfu⟧: exclamation and question marks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疑問符|ぎもんふ}→疑問符：24302_gimonfu⟧: question mark (？)
- ⟦{句読点|くとうてん}→句読点：08650_kutouten⟧: the Japanese period and comma (。、)
